body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Brother introduced its new digital sewing machine 'Quattro 6000D' during CES 2009, which features its exclusive InnovEye technology and an Up-close Viewer, projecting a magnified view of the needle area onto the wide-angle HD LCD display by Sharp.

This industry first is like having a built-in camera above the needle, so you can see exactly where the needle will be placed into the fabric. Nearly 32 square inches of display deliver razor sharp graphics and 260,000 possible colors with no color shifting.

Designs are rendered three times faster than previous models, and projects are viewed using Brother's Runway Lighting. Ten inches of full-spectrum lighting surround the needle area, equaling the power of 56 standard LED lights. Ease-of-use is further complemented with over 50 square inches of work space.
